title: Randomized phase II trial of nivolumab and ipilimumab with or without stereotactic body radiation therapy in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: the CheckPRO, CA209-8TY trial.

Patients and methods Trial design and patients The CheckPRO trial (CA209-8TY) was a single-center, investigator-initiated, randomized trial conducted at Herlev and Gentofte Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark ( online supplemental figure 1 ). Three of these received ICIs reinduction within the 52-week follow-up period ( figure 1 ).
